criteria.requirement: Implement tomlkit.files.load_with_digest(path) returning (UTF8 parsed_document,raw_bytes_sha256), and atomic_save(document,path,*,expected_digest=None) returning the new digest. Validate serialized TOML before I/O, check optional original digest before temp creation and before replacement, reject stale files with StaleDocumentError, preserve mode or choose 0600 for new files, flush/fsync a same-directory temporary then os.replace and clean failures. Reject symlinks and preserve old bytes on validation, staleness or replacement failure. Do not claim cross-process compare-and-swap locking or directory-fsync crash durability; ordinary parse/dump APIs stay unchanged.
